(2025) – note the number of species discrepancy is because the number in the reference includes only isoprene-derived species). As neither AMORE-Isoprene nor RCIM has stoichiometric invariants or emergent conservation from kinetic invariants, neither has an effective dimensionality lower than its respective number of species. Reduced intrinsic dimensionality from emergent conservation can be ruled out as a structural cause of the difference in fidelity between RCIM and its comparatively sized AMORE-Isoprene mechanism.
